text:
Amina: Quick proposal — soft-handshake eviction protocol to avoid token-stream cutover races when preemptible nodes get evicted. Short summary + steps below.

Amina: Goals: avoid duplicated tokens, keep tail-latency bounded, and allow cheap spot usage with safe fallbacks.

Amina: Proposal: on cloud preemptible signal, node publishes an EvictionEvent -> router enters a grace window for the affected leases -> in-flight streamers write a lightweight handoff marker to KV then let router route new attachments to fallback.

Amina: Event payload (example):
```json
{ "event": "eviction", "lease_id": "lease-abc123", "node": "gpu-07", "cutover_at": 1918765450, "ttl": 30, "fallback": "on-demand" }
```

Sam: Nice. How do you guarantee delivery? missing that event means we still race.

Ravi: we should publish to a durable stream (kafka/redis-streams) + write a small tombstone to node-metadata so router can poll if it misses the stream. consumer groups + acks.

Amina: Agreed. Implementation sketch: publish to eviction-stream, router subscribes with durable offset, fallback to control-plane poll if the eviction isn't seen in X ms. Also retry the publish with exponential backoff if ack not received.

Jess: Ops + metrics: record requeue_rate, handoff_marker_seen ratio, duplicate-token incidents, and 95/99 tail latency. Add a canary flag enable_eviction_soft_handshake (start 5% of fleet).

DevInfraBot: Created ticket INF-2026-824: "eviction soft-handshake" (P2) — assignees: @Amina, @Ravi.

Sam: Also add an idempotency header so requeued requests dedupe: `X-Origin-Req: <uuid>` and include streamer offset. Destination checks (req_id, offset) to drop duplicates.

Amina: Operational detail: streamer will write a single handoff marker near the cutover (not every token) to keep writes cheap. Marker schema: `kv:/streams/{session_id}/handoff -> {offset, origin_req_id, cutover_at}`. If KV write fails, fallback to immediate requeue with jittered backoff.

Ravi: Cost note: extra KV writes per stream could add up. Throttle markers: only on checkpoints (every N tokens) or when remaining lease window < threshold.

Jess: Testing: simulate preemptible signals in the runtime-simulator with 10k synthetic streams, validate no lost tokens and no more than 1% duplicate deliveries. Also validate tail latency under failover.

Amina: Rollout plan: dev environment -> staging synthetic canary -> 5% prod flag -> 25% -> 100%. Provide kill-switch `enable_eviction_soft_handshake=false`.

Sam: Ops runbook additions: how to debug marker absence, how to force re-publish an eviction event, and how to inspect requeue_idempotency logs.

Amina: I'll open a PR with code + small ops runbook + metrics dashboard. Items to own: Amina = implementation + PR, Ravi = durable stream infra and delivery guarantees, Jess = canary tests & dashboards.

Sam: sgtm
Ravi: sgtm
Jess: +1

Amina: Thanks — will follow up with PR and a short demo in next eng-runtime sync.
